name: SigNoz
tagline: Open source Datadog alternative. Logs, metrics, traces, in one platform.
shortDescription: SigNoz is an open source observability platform. Logs, metrics, and traces in one place, OpenTelemetry-native, beautiful UI, ClickHouse-backed. The open source Datadog/New Relic alternative.
longDescription:
## What it is

SigNoz is an open source observability platform. Logs, metrics, and traces in one place, OpenTelemetry-native (use any OTel SDK), ClickHouse-backed for fast queries, beautiful React UI, alerts, and dashboards.

## Why we recommend it

If you need Datadog/New Relic but with self-hosting and OpenTelemetry-native, SigNoz is the answer. The UI is excellent, the data is yours, and the cost is your infrastructure.

## When to use it

- Self-hosted Datadog alternative
- OpenTelemetry-native observability
- Logs + metrics + traces in one platform
- When you want to own your telemetry data
installCommand: git clone https://github.com/SigNoz/signoz.git && cd signoz/deploy/docker && docker compose up -d
installInstructions:
**Docker Compose (recommended):**
```
git clone https://github.com/SigNoz/signoz
cd signoz/deploy/docker
docker compose up -d
```
UI at http://localhost:3301.

**Cloud:** SigNoz Cloud from $0.30/GB ingested.
pricingDetails: Self-host: free. Cloud: $0.30/GB ingested. Free tier (10GB/month).
